correctness.rationale: For every pair (x,y) the atomic equality/addition diagram over {0,x,y} depends on five exceptional scalar slopes {0,1,−1,2,1/2} for p≥5 plus a generic case. For p=2 or 3 these coalesce; a generic pair is available for p=5 only if d≥2, and for any p≥7 already in dimension 1. For any fixed zero/nonzero survivor, the spectrum of pair diagrams after reassigning either variable depends solely on this six-way class. This gives an invariant 2-pebble back-and-forth relation for arbitrarily many moves, proving every FO² sentence agreement, not just bounded rank. Six distinct spectra have existential rank-two separators, and smallest class reps have orders 2,4,3,9,5,7, establishing max 9. Independent literal enumeration of all zero/equality/ternary-addition atoms and one-coordinate replacement repertoires for 9 prime/dimension examples agrees.
